   HOMŒOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA

           STIGMATA MAYDIS

         Corn-silk

        (ZEA)


Has marked urinary symptoms, and has been used with success in organic
        heart disease, with much œdema of lower extremities and scanty urination. Enlarged prostate
        and retention of urine. Uric and phosphatic Gonorrhœa. Cystitis.



Urinary.--  Suppression and   retention  .
        Dysuria. Renal lithiasis; nephritic colic; blood and red sand in urine. Tenesmus after
        urinating. Vesical catarrh. Gonorrhœa. Cystitis.



Shucks   (as a decoction used for chronic malaria, teaspoonful
        doses freely. Dr. E. C. Lowe, England).



Dose.--  Tincture in tent-to fifty-drop doses.
